title: Atlas 1.1 — Capability Registry
description: Catalog of capability flags an Agent Registry entry may claim. This file defines what each flag means and how risky it is; it does not grant capabilities to anyone. Hand-maintained: a new capability is proposed here before any agent entry can claim it.

risk_tier.description: HIGH = external-facing or canonical-write action (publish, merge, pay, contract); MEDIUM = local execution or non-canonical write; LOW = read-only / advisory
